title: mcp/submit_candidate/v1
description: The result of the submit_candidate tool (F26-T10; D-9, D-28, D-35 v3.39): its endpoint's (POST /reviews/<id>/candidates) response, passed through in an envelope, whether it accepted (201: the pull request, its append/ branch and the candidate record's path) or refused (400 candidate-not-blind, 404 review-unknown, 409 candidate-exists, 429 rate-limited, nothing opened); or an adapter error result.

oneOf.description: The endpoint's response, passed through (F09-R7): status, body, and Retry-After when the identity layer sent one (R8)
The plain path did not answer, or the arguments were refused (F09-R10)
